name: Second-Family Whole-Surface Representation Divergence
authority_basis: After Audit 10 returned zero automatic programs, Design Sol recommended the bounded second-family exploration path over successor refinement. The Director requested that Design Sol continue from that recommendation, authorizing Path 2 progression under the standing clean-recursive-audit delegation.
phase_b_problem: The current positive C0/O3/TYP/MAT/STA/MOT packets form one increasingly coherent provisional shared-brand system. The canonical Phase-B roadmap still requires at least two genuinely distinct surviving visual families before a deliberate convergence decision.
bounded_question: Can one genuinely distinct second visual family be established through a different whole-surface representation logic while preserving durable Kymaean human, relational, causal, epistemic and accessibility laws, without using the current provisional family as a construction seed?
program_law: Current C0 Threshold K, O3, TYP-02 F1 Ratio Ladder, MAT F1, STA F2, MOT F1A/CS2 and CLR-01 evidence may not supply candidate geometry, layout grammar, typography grammar, material topology, state treatment, motion grammar or palette construction.
Historical VID/hero exact casts, settings, compositions, palettes, props, architecture and renderer surfaces carry no inheritance rights.
Candidate premises must differ in positive whole-surface representation logic, not merely palette, camera, depth, decoration, polish or styling.
The first construction stage is premise-only and non-render. Candidate premise packets are frozen before any visual probe or comparison against current-family artifacts.

A first probe may establish only premise viability. Family survival requires a materially different transfer probe that preserves the same representation grammar without copying the first composition.
Current-family and historical-surface comparison occurs only after candidate premise/probe inputs are frozen; it is falsification evidence, not a source of candidate edits.
Zero surviving second families is valid. No evidence-aware reroll, family rescue or hidden fifth premise is allowed inside the frozen program.
If a genuinely distinct second family survives, stop at the Director convergence decision; do not automatically enter Phase C.
excluded_authority: CLR-01 reentry or final color selection
final symbol, wordmark, typeface, lockup, material, motion or state tokens
real product semantics or shipping app/site composition
app/site implementation, production assets, final identity or Phase-C convergence
next_action: Freeze the VFD-01 premise-construction, contamination, falsification, transfer, accessibility and termination method before generating or viewing any candidate premise or image.
